record.question: 'Thingfar Zan' is related to
record.explanation: Held. The printed page 9 confirms the stem and the four Mizo options, and 'Thingfar zan' is attested as a Mizo song in Mizo-language literature (the 1987 anthology 'Mizo Thawnthu' has the phrase 'An thingfar zan chuan nula' in a folktale), but I could not find any source stating which of the listed items it corresponds to; 'Dawino chhui' is a priestly rite and 'Chawngchen' a song/dance ('Chawngchen zai', 'Chawngchen lam'), and 'Lawithat zan' and 'Mitthi lumen zan' are songs, but no link to 'Thingfar zan' is documented. The Mizo-English dictionaries that would settle it (The New English-Zomi & Zomi-English Dictionary, 2012; The Concise Learner's Dictionary of Mizo, 2015) are lending-restricted on archive.org with no searchable OCR, and general web search was unreachable from this environment, so the item needs a verified Mizo-culture source.
